label: Phuket
short_description: Bonvoy beach resorts across Phuket, concentrated along Patong, Kamala, and the island's southern coast.
intro: Phuket's Bonvoy hotels are almost entirely resort-style, spread along the island's west-coast beaches from Patong and Kamala down to the quieter southern headlands. Elite perks here tend to center on resort credit, spa access, and room upgrades rather than the executive-lounge benefits more typical of city hotels, and the right beach often matters more to a stay than the specific property.
